body:
# Albumize ### *A sleek, high-performance screenshot management suite for the modern explorer.* [![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Version-1.21.1-red?style=for-the-badge)](https://modrinth.com/mod/albumize) [![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/Platform-Fabric-orange?style=for-the-badge)](https://fabricmc.net/) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-Join%20Us-7289DA?style=for-the-badge&logo=discord)](https://discord.gg/NPqYwmuyGk) ---
## ✨ Overview **Albumize** completely transforms your Minecraft screenshot experience. No more digging through messy file directories. Albumize provides a high-performance, fully customizable in-game suite to view, tag, organize, and share your memories instantly. --- ## 📸 Powerful Gallery Features * **In-Game Viewer:** Browse your entire collection without ever leaving the game. * **Full Preview Suite:** High-fidelity preview area with a dedicated Fullscreen mode. * **Smart Meta Display:** View file size, dimensions, and capture dates at a glance. * **Discord Ready:** Copy the actual image data directly to your system clipboard for instant sharing. --- ## 🏷️ Advanced Organization * **Dynamic Tagging:** Add custom tags to your shots for deep organization. * **Favorites System:** Star your best moments (★) to keep them front and center. * **Auto-Sort:** Automatically organizes new captures into Singleplayer and Multiplayer folders. * **Robust Search:** Real-time search by filename with comprehensive filters for tags and favorites. * **History Tracking:** Quick access to your last 50 viewed screenshots. --- ## 🎨 Fully Customizable UI * **Custom Accent Colors:** Match the UI to your style with RGB sliders and preset color themes. * **Modern Dark Theme:** A sleek, responsive interface designed for clarity and speed. * **Context Menus:** Right-click any screenshot for a quick-action menu (Copy, Rename, Delete, Open). * **Toast Notifications:** Real-time feedback for all actions like copying or file management. --- ## 🛠️ Controls & Navigation Open your gallery by pressing the **[G]** key (configurable in controls). | Feature | Action / Key | | :--- | :--- | | **Navigate** | `Arrow Keys` to browse / `Scroll Wheel` | | **Open Image** | `Enter` or `Double-Click` to open in system viewer | | **Manage Tags** | Open the dedicated `Tags Dialog` to bulk manage labels | | **Fast Copy** | Click `Copy Image` or use the `Context Menu` | | **System Access** | Click `Open Folder` to jump to the file location on your PC | --- ## 🧩 Compatibility & Technicals * ✅ **Cross-Platform:** Full clipboard and file support for Windows, macOS, and Linux. * ✅ **Sodium & Iris:** Optimized for high-performance rendering and shader screenshots. * ✅ **Mod Menu:** Fully persistent configuration saved to `albumize.json`. * ✅ **Real-Time Detection:** Automatically detects and organizes new screenshots as you take them. ---
